source.method: Pass 2: official portals/embassy pages read via curl/Playwright/fetch; only fields read on an official page are filled, others left null
caveats: Many portals block automated access (Cloudflare/Akamai): JO, PK, BH, DZ, CU, MA, ET, TZ forms
Rows only for countries where something better than current data was found

instructions.where: Online Saudi eVisa portal (Serbia is on the portal's list of 72 eligible countries); nearest Saudi embassy for non-eligible cases
instructions.processing: Instant/online per portal; fee shown in the portal before payment (not published on the public pages)
instructions.validity: One-year multiple-entry tourist eVisa, stay up to 90 days per visit
instructions.notes: Serbia appears on the official eligible-countries list (checked 2026-11-10). Tourist eVisa covers leisure, family visits and Umrah (not Hajj), excludes study/work. Public pages do not list documents or the fee; they are shown during the application.

instructions.where: Hayya platform (hayya.qa or Hayya app) - Tourist Visa (A1); Serbia is listed by Qatar Tourism among nationalities that apply for a tourist visa or pay for visa on arrival
documents: Passport valid at least 3 months from date of arrival
instructions.notes: Processing time and A1 validity not stated on the official Qatar Tourism page. GCC citizens need no visa. Per the Serbian MFA: visa required for Serbian citizens.

instructions.where: Kuwait Ministry of Interior e-visa portal (tourist visa); eligibility of Serbian nationality must be checked by selecting the nationality on the portal
instructions.validity: Entry permit valid 30 days from issuance; stay up to 90 days from entry; single entry (tourist)
instructions.notes: Visa holder may not work. The Serbian MFA states that neither an e-visa nor visa on arrival is available to Serbian citizens - confirm on the portal's nationality selector before applying. Fee not published on public pages.

instructions.where: Bahrain eVisa (NPRA portal) / services.bahrain.bh; alternative: Bahrain embassy in Moscow (non-resident accreditation)
documents: 3-month bank statement in English showing regular income of BHD 300-500 per month, or funds of BHD 150 per day of stay
instructions.fee: BHD 13 for the two-week single-entry Visit eVisa (BHD 9 visa fee + BHD 4 application fee)
instructions.notes: Per bahrain.bh service page the eVisa is open to nationals of 212 countries; the page does not name Serbia explicitly - confirm on the portal. Other eVisa types (multiple entry) have other fees. Embassy Moscow: moscow.mission@mofa.gov.bh, tel +7 499 995 0900.

instructions.where: Apply online via AVATS (irishimmigration.ie); documents submitted to the application office stated on the summary form (VFS Global visa centre Belgrade)
documents: Application letter (reason for visit, dates, accommodation, who pays)
Evidence of obligations to return home (employment, family, property)
Details of any previous visa refusals
instructions.fee: Single entry EUR 60; multiple entry EUR 100; transit EUR 25 (non-refundable; extra service charges may apply)
instructions.processing: About 8 weeks from receipt of application
instructions.validity: Short stay 'C' visa: up to 90 days
instructions.notes: Apply from home country, ideally 3 months before travel; do not buy tickets before approval. Original documents only, certified translation if not in English or Irish. Ireland does not issue e-visas. Valid UK short-stay visa may be usable under the Short Stay Visa Waiver Programme for approved nationalities.

instructions.where: Online application with Immigration New Zealand (Visitor Visa); NZeTA is not shown for Serbia on the pages read - check the visa tool
documents: Passport valid at least 3 months beyond planned departure
Proof of funds (about NZD 1,000 per month, or NZD 400 per month if accommodation prepaid)
Proof of onward ticket out of NZ or funds to buy one
Police certificate, chest X-ray or medical exam if requested
Translations into English of non-English documents
instructions.validity: Single entry up to 9 months in 18 months; multiple entry up to 6 months in each 12 months
instructions.notes: No work allowed (remote work for overseas employer may be allowed); study up to 3 months allowed.

instructions.where: Embassy of Malaysia, Belgrade - in person on working days 9:00-11:30 (appointments by phone/email), or eVisa online
documents: Completed visa application form IM.47 (one copy, A4 double-sided)
Copy of passport photo page (valid at least 6 months after entry, at least 1 blank page)
One photo 3.5 x 5.0 cm, white background
Copy of return air ticket (all destinations and transits)
Copy of each hotel booking for the stay
Invitation letter if travelling on business or staying with friends/relatives
instructions.processing: At least 3 working days if documents are in order
instructions.notes: Appointments: +381 11 2662 736, mwbelgrade@kln.gov.my (9:00-17:00; receptions 9:30-11:30). Travel insurance advised. From 1 Sep 2026 multiple-entry visas are restricted to 31 countries and specific travel purposes (Fly & Cruise, business etc.). Online eVisa documents per imi portal: photo, passport page valid 6+ months, return ticket, paid accommodation, proof of financial support.

instructions.where: Sri Lanka Electronic Travel Authorization (ETA) online
documents: Passport valid at least 6 months from arrival
instructions.fee: Tourist ETA, double entry 30 days: USD 50 for 'all other countries' (SAARC USD 20). Serbia is not on the list of 40 countries that get the 30-day ETA free since 25 May 2026
instructions.processing: Online; usually quick (not stated on the pages read)
instructions.validity: 30 days, double entry (up to 90 days by extension/fee)
instructions.notes: Serbia is not among the 40 free-ETA countries listed on eta.gov.lk (alert 01, effective 25.05.2026), so the standard fee table applies; confirm the current figure on the portal. Extension beyond 30 days via eservices.immigration.gov.lk.

instructions.where: Nepal Department of Immigration - online visa form (pre-fill), visa issued on arrival at Tribhuvan Airport/border, or at a Nepalese diplomatic mission
documents: Online tourist visa form receipt/barcode (valid 15 days)
instructions.fee: Tourist visa: 15 days USD 30; 30 days USD 50; 90 days USD 125 (online pre-payment adds 3.5% or NPR equivalent of USD 1)
instructions.processing: Pre-approval/ETA by email via DoI; on-arrival issue same day
instructions.validity: 15, 30 or 90 days; extension USD 3/day (min 15 days), max 150 days per visa year
instructions.notes: Re-entry +USD 25; overstay fine USD 5/day; children under 10 free. Some nationalities may not get on-arrival visas - confirm for Serbia with the DoI.

instructions.where: Visa on Arrival at Thai immigration checkpoints (Serbia listed among 3 eligible nationalities); Thai e-Visa (stickerless) for other stays
documents: Proof of funds: THB 10,000 per person / THB 20,000 per family
Passport valid at least 6 months with 2 blank pages
Fully paid onward ticket within 30 days of entry
instructions.fee: THB 2,000 (VOA, per Tourism Authority of Thailand; older page)
instructions.notes: Royal Thai Embassy Doha page effective 15 Sep 2026 lists Serbia for VOA. Fee is from an older TAT page - verify at the border/embassy.

instructions.where: South African Department of Home Affairs ETA portal (OR Tambo, Cape Town, Lanseria, King Shaka airports only); otherwise visa via VFS/SA mission
documents: Valid ordinary passport (validity per portal FAQ)
instructions.fee: Electronic processing fee ZAR 500 (per DHA gazette 17 Aug 2026)
instructions.validity: ETA valid up to 6 months from issue; stay up to 90 days
instructions.notes: Applicant must be 18+. Not valid for work. Passport validity rule differs between portal pages (FAQ: 7 months from travel and 30 days after visa expiry) - check the live form.

instructions.where: Tanzania e-visa portal (Immigration Services) or visa on arrival; embassy Rome
documents: Passport valid at least 6 months with one unused page
instructions.fee: Ordinary (single-entry) visa USD 50 (USA passports must take Multiple visa USD 100)
instructions.notes: Wait for visa grant notice by email before travel. Fees pre-paid and non-refundable. Apply only on the official site.

instructions.where: Gabon e-visa platform (arrival only via Libreville Leon M'ba airport); Gabon embassy in Moscow accredited for Serbia
documents: Copy of passport data page (valid 6+ months)
Colour photo 35 x 45 mm (under 6 months old)
instructions.fee: 1-3 months single entry EUR 70 or XAF 45,000 + EUR 15 file fee; 6 months multiple entry EUR 185 or XAF 120,000 + EUR 15 file fee (paid on arrival at delivery of visa sticker)
instructions.validity: 1-3 months single entry or 6 months multiple entry
instructions.notes: Extensions at DGDI Libreville (1-month visa +2 months; 2-month visa +1 month). Contact evisa@dgdi.ga, +241 01 77 03 24.

documents: Invitation letter (organisation or host with contacts)
instructions.notes: Fee shown in portal before payment. Cash limit USD 5,000.

instructions.where: Cuba eVisa portal (tourist visa) or Cuban consulates
documents: Valid passport for the whole stay
Email address to receive visa code
instructions.fee: Cost shown on the application form per consulate
instructions.validity: Tourist visa single entry, 90 days, extendable 90 days
instructions.notes: Separate D'Viajeros pre-arrival form may be required. Tourist visa does not cover business/journalist/work trips.

instructions.validity: See visa type (T, E, A, B, C)
instructions.notes: e-Visa accepted at Techo, Siem Reap-Angkor and Sihanoukville airports and Bavet and Tropaeng Kreal land borders; Cham Yeam and Poipet temporarily closed for e-visa. Cambodia e-Arrival form required within 7 days before arrival even for visa holders.

instructions.where: Mongolian diplomatic missions or border points (K2 tourist visa up to 30 days); e-visa at evisa.mn for eligible nationalities
documents: Copy of passport (valid 180 days before travel)
Two-way flight ticket confirmation if needed
Official invitation letter if travelling with family
instructions.fee: MNT 2,500 standard / MNT 5,000 expedited (Immigration Agency fee note)
instructions.processing: Standard 5 working days; expedite 3 working days
instructions.notes: E-visa (ETA) processing about 3 working days, non-extendable; whether Serbia is eligible for e-visa should be confirmed on evisa.mn.

instructions.where: Côte d'Ivoire e-visa via SNEDAI (only site recognised by the state); biometric enrolment at Abidjan airport
documents: Invitation letter or accommodation certificate (typed, signed, stamped, legalised)
On arrival: payment receipt, approved pre-enrolment document, passport valid 6+ months
instructions.fee: EUR 73 incl. bank charges (3 months, multiple entry)
instructions.processing: DST answer within 48 working hours, may take longer
instructions.validity: Pre-enrolment approval valid 3 months; 3-month multiple entry visa
instructions.notes: Ordinary passports only (6+ months validity). Max 1 MB per file. Biometric enrolment mandatory at airport.
